Metadata.title: Mithaq | Serious, trusted marriage introductions
Metadata.description: The technical foundation for Mithaq, a private marriage-introduction network for Libyans.

Foundation.statusBody: This page validates the technical architecture, bilingual routing, and directionality. Waitlist registration is not open in this milestone.
Foundation.privacyBody: This foundation does not collect registrations, photographs, or identity documents.
Foundation.rtlBody: Correct right-to-left Arabic and English support share one maintainable architecture.
Foundation.qualityBody: Testing, accessibility, and an offline-safe shell come before the registration journey.
Foundation.exampleBody: Content begins on the right in Arabic and on the left in English, while technical numbers stay readable.
Foundation.footer: Technical foundation only — no matching or messaging features exist in this release.

Connectivity.offlineDetail: The saved interface remains available, but submitting data will require a connection.
